# André Ringdorfer (苏文)

> Product manager in Hong Kong who builds AI agents and products, with a track record in onchain finance and a background in strategy consulting.

## AI work
- Forge: three self-hosted AI agents on a Raspberry Pi 5 (autonomous coding on a schedule, inbox-to-Telegram alerts, general requests). It has merged pull requests on its own.
- GoodInGoodOut: an AI calorie tracker. The Telegram bot is live; the iOS app is in development.
- Form D Oracle: an agent that hashes SEC Form D filings and anchors them onchain for verification (demo).
- AI video pipeline: open-source video generation with an AI judge-and-retry loop (in progress).
- Keepr: an AI personal CRM over Telegram.
- AEO toolkit: audits and rewrites that make websites readable by AI answer engines.

## Crypto track record
- Chakra Pool: onchain yield vaults, $18M+ liquidity.
- HeliSwap: Hedera's first native DEX, $2.5M Hedera Foundation grant, $7M+ TVL.
- Sherpa Stake: staking platform, $1B+ in tokens at peak.
- Developer course with Metaschool: 7,000+ developers.
- RWAccelerator with Google Cloud: 7 projects selected from 150+.
- ETHGlobal hackathon prizes: $14K+.
